_note: Placeholder prices and what fits in each load (content/placeholders.md). The ticket's chips carry the same prices in src/partials/ticket.html, and the FAQ's answers in data/faq.json; change all three.

cards.label: 1/8 truck

cards.label: 1/4 truck
cards.fits: A room's worth: a bedroom set, or a pile of boxes and bags.

cards.label: 1/2 truck
cards.fits: A small garage or basement clean out.

cards.label: Full truck
cards.fits: A packed garage, a full basement or a whole move-out.
